Sit back and relax in this quiet, modern place. It's a quiet neighborhood, with good hiking opportunities nearby. In winter, there are good opportunities for skiing.

The space
Modern homes with good standard, location near OSL airport, and Lillestrøm. 

The house is 138 km2 and has 2 floors. Two bathrooms. Open plan with kitchen and living room. 

On the second floor you will find a small living room, bathroom and bedrooms. 

Your bed will have new linen, a large and a small towel are available for each person, and will be on the bed upon arrival.

Our stay was truly wonderful. The house is newly built, beautifully decorated, and very comfortable. Parking was easy and convenient. It’s just a short 500-meter walk to the Kniplia Road bus station, where we could catch Bus 400 — which worked perfectly since we didn’t take our car to Oslo, as suggested by others.

Overall, we had an amazing experience. Thanks again for being such an amazing host!
